method: Haversine geodesic coordinate comparisons, no route or ownership inference
policy: Geographic comparison only. No coordinate, nearby road, tourism listing, name similarity or distance establishes landowner permission, legal parking, trail access, current opening or visitor directions.

clusters.label: Upper Silver Falls near Herman
clusters.findings: Michigan GIS #68 agrees with two independent waterfall-coordinate sources near Herman. It is about 12.4 km south of the distinct lower Silver picnic falls #110. The rough informal upstream path near the lower picnic area is NOT the #68 Herman waterfall. Property title, access permission and visitor parking are not verified.

clusters.label: Mill Pond Falls name cluster, Sundholm Creek
clusters.findings: The three points are distinct geographic labels in approximately one kilometer, not established aliases, trail stops or three separately confirmed public waterfalls. GNIS-derived secondary coordinates are research evidence only; consult original GNIS records before treating identities as resolved.

clusters.label: Alger Falls near M-28/M-94
clusters.findings: The adopted City of Munising 2024-2028 recreation plan and Alger County recreation inventory state that no safe parking options were available when reviewed. Secondary advice to use a highway turnout or cross a guardrail is not an MDOT site-specific safety authorization. Current MDOT designated stopping, pedestrian path and land tenure remain unverified.
